# `network/realm/atlas/AtlasProviders.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/atlas/AtlasProviders.js`

Feature-gated Atlas provider contracts with bounded verified in-memory stores.

## Classes

### `class AtlasRecordProvider`

A complete bounded provider suitable for local, direct-contact, organization, and peer-gossip adapters. Network code passes verified records into this contract; no provider becomes active until explicitly enabled.
